relationships.subject: hyperlipidemia
relationships.evidence_quote: Hyperlipidemia significantly upregulated the gene expression of TLR4, YY1, TWIST1, COL1, COL3, MMP1, and MMP3 (p < 0.05), as shown in Fig. 3A.

relationships.subject: YY1
relationships.evidence_quote: YY1, in turn, directly binds to the COL1 promoter, promoting COL1 gene expression [33].

relationships.subject: YY1
relationships.evidence_quote: YY1 is known to suppress MMP3, which activates both MMP1 and MMP9 [43,44].

relationships.subject: TRAF6
relationships.evidence_quote: Although TRAF6 expression remained stable in hyperlipidemic conditions, likely due to the increased expression of CD40 and TLR4, it activated the transcription factor YY1.

key_findings: Hyperlipidemia raised TLR4, YY1, TWIST1, COL1 mRNA in swine rotator cuff tendon, but protein largely unchanged
MMPs including MMP9 were present in inactive forms, preserving collagen
